name: Exp_i4_DRF_v3
summary: This EA implements a trend-following strategy based on the i4 (Intraday Intuition Index) and DRF (Dynamic Range Filter) indicators, entering trades when both indicators align in the same direction. It uses dynamic range filtering to identify trend conditions and the i4 indicator for momentum confirmation, with version 3 incorporating additional filtering and risk management refinements. The system operates systematically with predefined entry/exit rules and adjustable position sizing.
summary_zh: 该EA基于i4指标（盘中直觉指数）和DRF指标（动态范围过滤器）实现趋势跟踪策略，当两个指标方向一致时入场交易。它使用动态范围过滤来识别趋势条件，并用i4指标进行动量确认，第3版本增加了额外的过滤和风险管理优化。系统以系统化方式运行，具有预定义的入场/出场规则和可调节的仓位管理。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用双指标确认的趋势跟踪策略，核心逻辑是i4指标与DRF动态范围过滤器的联合信号判定。入场条件要求两个指标同时发出同方向信号，i4指标负责动量方向的判断，DRF指标负责过滤震荡行情并确认趋势的有效性。出场条件包括指标反向信号触发平仓以及预设的止损止盈水平，确保每笔交易都有明确的风险边界。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例计算方式，通过参数可调节每笔交易的风险敞口。资金管理方面，EA提供了最大持仓限制和最大回撤控制参数，避免在不利行情中过度暴露风险。整体策略设计强调信号确认的严格性，减少假突破带来的亏损交易。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a dual-indicator confirmation trend-following strategy, with the core logic relying on joint signal determination from the i4 indicator and the DRF Dynamic Range Filter. Entry conditions require both indicators to simultaneously emit signals in the same direction, where the i4 indicator handles momentum direction judgment and the DRF filter eliminates choppy market conditions while confirming trend validity. Exit conditions include indicator reversal signals triggering position closure and preset stop-loss/take-profit levels, ensuring every trade has a defined risk boundary. Position sizing uses either fixed lot sizes or account-balance-proportional calculations, with parameters allowing adjustment of risk exposure per trade. For money management, the EA provides maximum position limits and maximum drawdown control parameters to avoid excessive risk exposure during adverse market conditions. The overall strategy design emphasizes strictness of signal confirmation to reduce losing trades caused by false breakouts.

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号用于标识订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for order identification

pros: 双指标联合确认机制有效减少假信号入场，提高交易胜率
DRF动态范围过滤器能自适应市场波动变化，避免在震荡行情中频繁交易
具备止损止盈和最大持仓限制等风险控制参数，资金管理较为完善
参数化设计灵活，交易者可根据不同品种和市场环境调整策略参数
pros_en: Dual-indicator confirmation mechanism effectively reduces false signal entries and improves win rate
DRF Dynamic Range Filter adapts to market volatility changes, avoiding frequent trades in choppy conditions
Includes stop-loss/take-profit and maximum position limits for robust risk control
Flexible parameterized design allows traders to adjust strategy settings for different instruments and market conditions
cons: 双指标确认机制可能导致入场滞后，在快速反转行情中错过最佳入场时机
趋势跟踪策略在横盘震荡市场中容易产生连续亏损
缺乏对交易时段和重大新闻事件的过滤机制，可能在流动性差或高波动时段产生不利交易
固定止损止盈参数未考虑ATR等动态波动指标，在不同波动率环境下可能不适配
cons_en: Dual-indicator confirmation may cause entry lag, missing optimal entry points during fast market reversals
Trend-following strategies tend to produce consecutive losses in sideways/ranging markets
Lacks trading session and major news event filters, potentially generating unfavorable trades during low-liquidity or high-volatility periods
Fixed stop-loss/take-profit parameters don't account for dynamic volatility indicators like ATR, potentially misaligning with different volatility environments
improvements: 建议增加ATR动态止损止盈机制，根据市场波动率自动调整止损止盈距离
建议添加交易时段过滤和新闻事件回避功能，减少非理想交易环境下的亏损
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop-loss/take-profit mechanism to automatically adjust SL/TP distances based on market volatility
Implement trading session filters and news event avoidance to reduce losses in suboptimal trading environments

risk_points: 趋势跟踪策略在震荡市中可能连续止损，导致资金回撤较大
缺乏交易时段过滤可能在流动性不足时段产生滑点较大的交易
未检测到基于ATR的动态止损机制，固定止损在高波动行情中可能过小
risk_points_en: Trend-following strategy may incur consecutive stop-losses in ranging markets, leading to significant drawdowns
Lack of trading session filters may produce trades with excessive slippage during low-liquidity periods
No ATR-based dynamic stop-loss detected; fixed stops may be too tight during high-volatility conditions
